name: Jeolmanghui Jeon-ya ~The Prologue~
source:
Materials about the "World Tree" on an ancient island are stolen from the underground library of modern wizards. An external wizard becomes the main suspect. Two wizard hunters are dispatched to return the stolen materials.
At the same time there is a normal student who transfers from school to school in attempt to run away from recurring nightmares. One day fantasy starts to interfere with the reality.
Both story-lines eventually collide in a fateful encounter, and world is brought on the brink of destruction.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/07/vn-of-month-february-2008-switch-boku.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
有关古代岛屿上“世界树”的资料，从现代魔法师的地下图书馆中遭到盗窃。一名外来魔法师成为主要嫌疑人，两名魔法师猎人奉命追回失窃资料。
与此同时，一名普通学生为了逃避反复出现的噩梦，不断从一所学校转到另一所学校。某天，幻想开始侵入现实。
两条故事线最终在命运般的邂逅中交汇，世界也被推到毁灭边缘。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/07/vn-of-month-february-2008-switch-boku.html]vndbreview[/url]]
